note: Model tiers as DATA, not code. A hardcoded tier table goes stale the moment a lineup changes, and it goes stale silently — the guards keep running and simply stop classifying correctly. Override without waiting for a plugin release by writing a file of this shape to $CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA/model-tiers.json; it is merged over these defaults by alias, so you can add one model or change one rank without restating the rest.

sonnet.note: bounded edits, short scripts, multi-file work

fable.note: not a routing tier — an exception requiring a stated warrant

mythos.note: same tier and treatment as fable

unknownNote: A model matching no entry is treated as PREMIUM and flagged. Defaulting an unrecognised model to cheap would let a new top-tier model bypass the warrant and the cap on the day it ships — the exact window in which nobody has updated the table yet. Fail toward the expensive assumption; the cost of a spurious warrant is one line in a brief.
